aicss.purpose: Generate front / side / back view of a character in one go
notes: Modify the character description in nodes 2/3/4 (FRONT/SIDE/BACK PROMPT). Keep the keywords character turnaround [view] at the start.
Three KSamplers use fixed seeds (100/101/102) for reproducibility. Change to 'randomize' to get variations.
Use small random offsets like 100/101/102 so front/side/back look consistent.
Node 18 (ImageGrid) stitches the three views into one image for easy review.
For better consistency, install ComfyUI-IPAdapter and load a reference face embedding.
